card.name: Scattered punctuation and citation markers in science text
card.fires_on: Weak, mixed responses in science or nature-fact text: citation numbers in parentheses like (3), the word 'off' in 'mark off', and list words in the laws of reflection.

modes.label: Citation markers
modes.description: Parentheses and numbers for reference citations after a sentence about an animal.
modes.example: The forelimbs are relatively short, while the contrastingly long and muscular hind-limbs enable it run and jump with ease (3)<< (>>4).

modes.label: Geometry instructions
modes.description: The word 'off' or a full stop in a step-by-step paper-folding or construction description.

modes.label: Optics laws
modes.description: Words inside the list of reflection laws, such as 'the' and 'reflected'.
modes.example: The incident, reflected ray, and<< the>> normal are in the same plane.
